details.focus: Official Physics press releases for all ten years 2015–2024 yielded 28 laureates with exact verifiable quotes for names, years, affiliations and motivations, but 26 nationality cells were absent. Separate nationality research was necessary; birthplace and employer country were deliberately not treated as citizenship evidence. Preserve this field-specific distinction in reusable research guidance.

details.summary: Strengthen reconciliation of complementary evidence and preserve field-specific research as a skill. Treat the empty output as an unfinished snapshot, not a proven submission failure.

edits.title: Reconcile complementary evidence before accepting extracted cells
edits.content: Extraction can discard supported multivalued facts through last-record-wins assignment or by choosing one short quote while ignoring complementary sources. Group records by entity key and field before mutation, and compare each proposed value against all supplied relevant evidence, even when extraction returns exactly one record per entity. Flag omitted complementary facts and conflicting claims. Distinguish citizenship from regional identity, ancestry, birthplace and employer country; retain dates of citizenship changes and apply the task's temporal scope. Exact quote membership establishes textual fidelity, not completeness or semantic support. If no single contiguous quote supports the complete value required by the output contract, keep the cell pending and seek a suitable source; do not silently drop facts or concatenate unrelated quotations.

edits.title: Research missing fields separately from authoritative roster evidence
edits.content: For a bounded award or historical roster, fetch official releases for each requested period and extract the roster, dates, award-time affiliations and person-specific motivations. For split awards, match each recipient to the applicable motivation. Validate populated cells against fetched text and inventory unresolved entity-field pairs. An authoritative source for award details may omit nationality: leave that field pending and research it separately using explicit nationality or citizenship evidence. Never infer citizenship from birthplace, residence or institutional country. Preserve supported multiple affiliations and nationalities, reconcile complementary or conflicting sources, and apply the requested temporal scope. Reuse validated cells and cached sources while researching only unresolved fields; finish with coverage, semantic-support and exact-quote checks.

decisions.reason: The self-check reports empty output and no submitted citations or constraint checks, but the trajectory ends during nationality extraction without a completed root iteration or final submission. The last budget still shows substantial time and calls available. This establishes unfinished work at the snapshot, not a demonstrated failure to finalize; adding a submission reminder would duplicate the immutable output instructions without establishing the cause.

All 33 occurrences were considered: the nine release searches had no explicit laureate names in their returned hits, while the other 24 were nationality verification searches for people already extracted from releases. Results were inspected before recording empty discoveries, and those searches supplied useful field evidence. Entry 0 already permits honest empty records for verification searches. These signals do not support inventing discoveries, repeating searches, or deleting the existing guidance.

The Princeton 403, Max Planck 401 and AP 403 were all retained as failures and excluded from extraction evidence. Successful alternatives supplied proposed nationality cells for the affected people through Wikipedia, Lindau and Le Monde. Final validation is not visible, so recovery is only established through extraction. Entry 3 already covers retaining successful downloads, excluding failure sentinels and validating alternatives; no additional rule or domain blacklist is warranted.

The release extraction produced 28 staged rows across all ten requested years, with the diagnostic reporting only 26 missing nationality cells and no quote mismatches. Separate nationality searches then supplied explicit evidence. This is a successful intermediate procedure worth preserving as a skill, without claiming the unfinished table passed final checks. Existing entries cover validation and fetch recovery but not this division of evidence by field.

The supplied nationality evidence included an additional citizenship claim for Thouless and a dated citizenship acquisition for Haldane, yet extraction returned only United Kingdom for each. The proposed acceptance loop checks nonempty fields and quote membership, which would not detect these omissions. No later reconciliation is visible. Extend entry 2 beyond duplicate returned records to complementary source evidence, preserving temporal and semantic review rather than storing person-specific answers.

The discovery code initialized known names from the roster but compared only casefolded strings, so shortened names and a straight-apostrophe variant were recorded as new people. This supports an alias-resolution lesson, but no duplicate final rows are shown. With two edits available, field-specific research and demonstrated omissions of complementary evidence have greater impact; retain the existing honest-discovery guidance.

edits.content: For a bounded award or historical roster, fetch official releases for each requested period and extract the roster, dates, award-time affiliations and person-specific motivations. Never infer citizenship from birthplace, residence or institutional country. Preserve supported multiple affiliations and nationalities, reconcile complementary or conflicting sources, and apply the requested temporal scope. Reuse validated cells and cached sources while researching only unresolved fields. Before counting a profile as field coverage, verify its subject, relevant period and requested field in the fetched text; a matching domain, URL fragment or search query does not establish identity. General topic pages and co-recipient profiles must not replace evidence for the target person. Distinguish a located candidate from a fetched, matched and verified field. Account explicitly for omitted extraction results. When profile searches stop yielding relevant evidence, inspect already collected links and alternate official documents; if a restrictive exact-phrase query is empty, change the retrieval route rather than repeatedly tightening it. Use a cached announcement when it supports the complete field, and keep genuine gaps pending. Finish with coverage, semantic-support and exact-quote checks.

edits.title: Reconcile complementary evidence before accepting extracted cells
edits.content: Extraction can discard supported multivalued facts through last-record-wins assignment or by choosing one short quote while ignoring complementary sources. Group records by entity key and field before mutation, and compare each proposed value against all supplied relevant evidence, even when extraction returns exactly one record per entity. Before replacing a populated cell, compare its supported components with the replacement: a newer or more structured authoritative page may omit a collaboration or institution that another official source explicitly attributes to the person. Preserve complementary components unless evidence establishes that they are incorrect or outside the field's defined scope. Distinguish award-listed affiliations from other career roles and apply the same scope throughout the review. Flag omitted complementary facts and conflicting claims. Distinguish citizenship from descriptive nationality, regional identity, ancestry, birthplace, permanent residence and employer country; retain dates of citizenship changes and apply the task's temporal scope. Do not automatically distribute a collective citizenship assertion to each person when individual evidence conflicts; compare specificity, provenance and dates, and retain unresolved uncertainty. A citizenship test or migration history alone does not prove completed naturalization. Supply reviewers with the relevant supporting and conflicting passages rather than asserting that an earlier conclusion is corroborated. Exact quote membership establishes textual fidelity, not completeness or semantic support. If no single contiguous quote supports the complete value required by the output contract, keep the cell pending and seek a suitable source; do not silently drop facts or concatenate unrelated quotations.

additional_candidates.description: URL-pattern selection admitted general Facts pages and another person's profile; selected URLs were counted as coverage before subject and field verification.
Replacing an affiliation cell with a narrower official source removed an already supported collaboration, requiring a final repair.
Collective citizenship claims required individual conflict checks, while a later audit asserted corroboration absent from its supplied evidence.
Case-fold-only discovery tracking counted shortened names and apostrophe variants of existing roster members as new entities.
Staged extraction, exact-quote checks and semantic audits recovered attribution and completeness problems before final submission.

decisions.reason: All five occurrences are zero-hit exact-name/exact-affiliation-phrase searches in the late verification batch, overlapping five stalled labels rather than five additional retries. Earlier broader searches had already failed to locate those personal profiles. The final batch also produced off-target results, and recovery used cached official announcements. This supports a bounded change of retrieval route and evidence-based fallback, not an assumption that missing search hits mean missing facts. The existing roster skill is extended rather than creating another search entry.

All 83 occurrences were reviewed: nine annual-release searches, 24 nationality searches, five initial focused checks, two citizenship follow-ups, 24 affiliation searches, nine broader Facts searches, two further nationality searches and eight exact-phrase affiliation searches. Seventy-eight returned hits; five overlap the empty-search group. Initial snippets often lacked names, and later searches verified known people, so empty discovery lists mostly reflect honest accounting already covered by entry 0. Successful roster extraction, nationality evidence and affiliation repairs contradict treating all 83 labels as wasted research. However, repeated profile-location rounds and counting unsuitable URLs as coverage demonstrate a narrower process gap: track verified field progress and stop an ineffective retrieval route. Edit 0 addresses that gap while retaining honest empty discoveries; passing final checks does not erase the avoidable search work.

All six failures were examined: Princeton, AP and Prabook returned 403, Max Planck returned 401, Delo entered a redirect loop, and the Washington Post download broke. Usable companion sources supported continued extraction; later individual-source checks resolved gaps without making every failed URL succeed. The final broken-pipe sentinel was unnecessarily passed to a model, which correctly refused extraction. Entry 3 already explicitly requires excluding failure sentinels, retaining successful downloads, using alternatives and validating replacements. Its usage/outcomes arrays are empty, so these events do not demonstrate repeated failure of an applied skill. No new retry policy or domain blacklist is warranted; the two edits address uncovered attribution and reconciliation problems instead.

The selection code accepted URL fragments without establishing the page subject; a valid slashless URL was initially missed, general Facts pages inflated coverage, and another laureate's profile displaced the intended person's announcement. Later extraction rejected the mismatch and a targeted announcement repair succeeded. Edit 0 adds subject/period/field validation and explicit coverage stages without treating unusual URL spelling as failure.

Facts-page updates overwrote existing affiliation cells, and the final semantic review identified a collaboration lost from an otherwise valid institutional listing. The final repair restored it with announcement evidence. Entry 2 already covers complementary extraction, but needs an explicit comparison before authoritative-source replacement and a stable affiliation scope. Edit 1 closes that recovered failure mode.

Reconciliation initially promoted a collective citizenship claim, then individual citizenship/permanent-residence evidence forced a more specific assessment. The review also noted that taking a citizenship test did not prove naturalization. A later audit prompt nevertheless asserted corroboration while supplying only selected final sources. The existing reconciliation memory needs explicit claim-type distinctions, individual conflict assessment and evidence-supplied review rather than conclusion-led review. Edit 1 preserves these procedures without storing person-specific answers or declaring the final nationality values incorrect.

The case-fold-only comparison treated shortened names and an apostrophe variant as new entities despite an established roster. This is a supported accounting defect, but it did not duplicate final keyed rows, whose uniqueness was checked. With two edits available, source attribution and loss of supported field components take priority. Entry 0's honest recording guidance remains useful; repeated stalled labels alone do not show that it consistently fails.

Structural and exact-quote checks passed before semantic reviews found attribution and completeness defects; focused repairs and final checks completed the run. This repeatable tactic is already covered by entries 1 and 4, so a separate skill would duplicate them. All recorded entry outcomes are passing with empty issue lists, while entry 3 has no usage; there is no evidence for deleting an entry as consistently harmful. Mechanical self-check success is retained as limited evidence, not proof that every semantic judgment was sound.
